summary: All five SPEC items are implemented as designed. tools/lint/type-stripping.js matches the §5 design exactly. It is registered before headlessBoundaryConfig, and the headless block spreads the shared selectors (D-1). tsconfig sets erasableSyntaxOnly, and sandbox CONFIG_FILES includes the new file. The tests are discriminating. SPEC-01 runs the real loader on the real entry. SPEC-02's negative controls show that the loader rejects both blockers. SPEC-03's src/advice probes would fail if the headless spread were dropped. SPEC-04's dyn-probe would fail if the block order were reversed, and ok-probe catches false positives. I ran both new test files: 4/4 pass. The build-1 gate passes lint, typecheck, test and the scope budget. There are no BLOCKER or MAJOR findings and one NIT.
